summary: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model powering Microsoft 365 Copilot across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat, and Cowork.

mechanisms.reason: GPT-5.6 becoming the preferred model across a suite of high-volume Microsoft productivity surfaces increases aggregate inference calls served.
